item.title: Five of Nine Bathers Go Missing in Brahmaputra in Guwahati’s Kharguli; Rescue Operation Underway
item.description: GUWAHATI: Five persons went missing in the Brahmaputra while four others managed to reach the bank after they went for a bath in the river in the Kharghuli area on Wednesday, December 10, afternoon. item.title: UIDAI to Ban Collection and Storage of Physical Aadhaar Photocopies

item.title: Assam Observes Swahid Diwas in Guwahati’s New Memorial
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam observed Swahid Diwas on Wednesday, December 10, at the newly constructed Swahid Smarak Kshetra in Boragaon, Guwahati, where the state government formally opened the memorial dedicated to the martyrs of the 1979–1985 Assam Movement. The structure has been described as the first official memorial honouring those killed during the movement. item.title: Delhi HC Orders IndiGo to Compensate Flyers, Slams Govt for Fare Spike
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Delhi High Court on Wednesday, December 10, directed crisis-hit IndiGo to compensate passengers stranded at airports after the sudden cancellation of thousands of flights, even as it sharply criticised the Centre for failing to prevent airfares from skyrocketing to as high as ₹35,000–₹40,000 on key routes. item.title: Will Australia's Under-16 Social Media Ban Influence India?
item.description: GUWAHATI: As Australia enforces the world’s first across-the-board prohibition on social media usage for children under 16, the ripple effects are already being felt globally. While governments in Europe and Asia scrutinise the rollout, the development has presented a unique scenario for India. item.title: India's Deepavali Inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage List
item.description: GUWAHATI: India’s Deepavali festival was on Wednesday, December 10, added to UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. The decision was announced during a key meeting of UNESCO held at the Red Fort in Delhi. item.title: Assam Artisans Receive National Handicraft Awards from President Murmu
item.description: GUWAHATI: Two artisans from the state, Bapukan Payeng of Majuli and Sabina Teronpi of Karbi Anglong, have been conferred with National Handicrafts Awards by President Droupadi Murmu in New Delhi. The recognition was given for their contributions to traditional weaving forms of their respective communities. item.description: GUWAHATI: Five persons were arrested on Tuesday evening, December 9, for allegedly hunting wild birds at Bholakata Beel in Assam’s Biswanath district, during a joint operation by the Central Range, Biswanath Ghat, and the Crime Investigation Range. item.title: Major Hours-long Fire Continues to Burn in Guwahati Commercial Building; No Casualties Reported
item.description: GUWAHATI: A massive fire broke out at the popular Swagota Square building at ABC point during the early hours of Wednesday, December 10, triggering panic and causing extensive damage. The fire is reported to have started from Hamleys, a toy store, before spreading upwards to several floors of the SBI branch. The ground floor houses Sohum Emporia. item.title: Firefighters Break Into Building in Guwahati's ABC After 35-Hour Blaze
